programs.title: Dus
programs.desc: Jambval, a terrorist, plans to wreak havoc in Canada during Indian PM's visit there. Now, Siddharth, the head of the Indian Anti-Terrorist Squad, must lead his team to uproot Jambval's plans and apprehend dreaded terrorist.

programs.title: Aankhen
programs.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.
